description: Using Oracle SQL Developer (already connected to the HR schema), write a SQL query that ranks employees by salary within each department and returns the top 5 highest-paid employees overall. The result should include the employee's name, their department name, salary, and salary rank within their department. Generate the explain plan for this query and save the complete plan output (including the SQL query text and all plan operations) to /home/ga/Documents/exports/explain_plan_output.txt.
